<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex35022023-08-0308-50-15" status="finalized" ana="corpusmd:colophon"><milestone unit="section" n="Colophon (74a5-8) (p. 175:5-8)"/>
            de ltar na <rs type="work" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3727">byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la 'jug pa</rs> ni spyi don 3 gyis bstan cing bshad par bya ba legs par bshad pa <abbr>yin no</abbr> || mkhas pa'i rjes su las pas rab <lb n="74a6"/> zhugs te || rang gi nus pa cung zad gsal byas la || don dang <abbr>tshig gi</abbr> skyon du gang gyur pa || <abbr>thams cad</abbr> bla ma mkhas rnams bzod par gsol || || ldan rnams kyis de nyid gsol 'debs dang || zhum pa rnams kyi spro ba skyed byed dang || rigs ldan rgyas pa'i sa bon gdab pa'i phyir || <abbr>slob dpon</abbr> de'i <lb n="74a7"/> gzhung lugs de <abbr>bshad do</abbr> || de las dge ba bskrun pa de || skul dang grogs byed dad pa dang || blo ldan gang zag rnam 2 la || byin dge lus can kun la bsngo || <rs type="work" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4712"><rs type="work" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3727">byang chub seMs dpa'i spyod pa 'jug pa</rs>'i <abbr>tshig gi</abbr> don zhib du rnam par 'byed pa dga' ba rgya mtsho</rs> zhes bya ba | <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3880">shag kya'i dge slong <lb n="74a8"/> a rmi ta kir ti</rs>s bkrol zin to || dge par gyur cig <note type="editorial">The final line "dge par..." is written without tsheg or space between the syllables</note> |</seg></TEI>
